summary: The board specifies the words and leaves {designer} a choice of where to put them.
realLife: On the Shirley Chisholm medal, members wanted the congressional authorization marked and gave the Mint discretion to put it on either face.
gates: The medal must carry an authorization inscription and either face is under review.
inGame: needs: authorization inscription and design proofs.

turns.what: The lettering fits under the portrait.
turns.pulledBy: The engraver's proof leaves enough room there.
turns.writesBack: The proof identifies the front as the inscription side.

turns.what: Neither face has room at the requested size.
turns.pulledBy: Both trial impressions crowd an existing line.
turns.writesBack: The board gets a new lettering proof.
